entities.summary: Charles "Hawkeye" Whitney is an American former professional basketball player. After starring at North Carolina State, he was drafted by the Kansas City Kings in the first round of the 1980 NBA draft. A knee injury limited Whitney's professional career to just 70 games, and by 1989 he was homeless and addicted to cocaine.
